name: openoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @openoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @openoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @openoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @openoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @openoffice/project-store
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @openoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @openoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @openoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @openoffice/file-parse
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @openoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @openoffice/docs && npm run build -w @openoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @openoffice/slides && npm run build -w @openoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @openoffice/markdown
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:mac -w @openoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @openoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @openoffice/shell
